title: System Metrics Collection and Logging
summary: This module is responsible for collecting system-level metrics such as event counters and queue depths. It initializes logging, updates metric values, generates a snapshot of current metrics, and logs this snapshot for monitoring.

nodes.label: Collect & Log System Metrics
nodes.title: System Metrics Runner
nodes.description: Orchestrates the entire metrics collection process, including logging setup, metric value updates, snapshot generation, and logging the final metrics data for system monitoring.

nodes.label: Configure Logging
nodes.title: Logging Configuration
nodes.description: Sets up the logging environment, defining parameters such as the logging level and the destination for log messages, ensuring proper observability.

nodes.label: Manage Metrics Data
nodes.title: Metrics Collector
nodes.description: An internal component that manages the lifecycle of various metrics, allowing for their creation, incremental updates, and the generation of a comprehensive snapshot.

nodes.label: Metrics Snapshot Data
nodes.title: Collected Metrics Snapshot
nodes.description: A structured, immutable data object containing the current values of all collected system metrics, such as event counters and gauge readings, at a specific moment.

nodes.label: Output Metrics Log
nodes.title: Metrics Log Destination
nodes.description: Represents the external interface or destination where the processed metrics snapshot is written, typically for persistent storage, real-time dashboards, or debugging.
